parameters.query:
-- Get AWHL pages that haven't been crawled yet
SELECT p.id, p.url, p.domain_id, d.domain
FROM wellness.pages p
JOIN wellness.domains d ON p.domain_id = d.id
WHERE d.domain IN ('haach.com', 'drhaach.com', 'natrahea.com.sg', 'guotaitcm.com')
  AND p.page_type = 'content'
  AND p.last_crawled_at IS NULL
LIMIT 50;
UPDATE wellness.pages SET last_crawled_at = NOW(), last_http_status = $2 WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id;
